team.public_description: A representative AWS GenAI team synthesized from publicly available professional profiles.
limitations: The members are a research sample assembled from public professional evidence and are not asserted to share a reporting line, department, or project.
The agenda is an evidence-grounded synthesis of their public technical work, not an AWS-authored roadmap.
Real names and public URLs are retained only for provenance; the demo should display aliases AWS Engineer A-F.
All individual knowledge remains claimed until separately verified through a job-relevant interview or authorized work sample.

agenda.north_star: Build a production-grade enterprise generative and agentic AI platform on AWS that is grounded in authorized enterprise knowledge, coordinates specialized agents, and embeds identity, governance, evaluation, observability, and resilience by design.
agenda.short_demo_label: Secure, grounded, observable, and resilient Agentic AI on Amazon Bedrock

workstreams.name: Enterprise Knowledge and Retrieval
workstreams.objective: Ground agents and generative AI applications in current enterprise data with scalable retrieval and explicit document access control.
deliverables: Managed and custom RAG patterns using Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases
Multimodal ingestion and retrieval
Metadata filtering and real-time ACL enforcement
Retrieval traces and CloudWatch observability

workstreams.name: GenAI Platform Engineering
workstreams.objective: Provide a repeatable platform for deploying and governing models, prompts, tools, agents, and application workloads across environments.
deliverables: AgentCore Runtime deployment workflows
Model and prompt lifecycle controls
Reusable platform components and infrastructure automation
Centralized cost, rate-limit, scaling, and operational controls

workstreams.name: Evidence-Aware Multi-Agent Systems
workstreams.objective: Coordinate specialized agents that can discover capabilities, delegate tasks, and validate outputs against authoritative sources with human oversight.
deliverables: Sequential and hub-and-spoke multi-agent workflows
A2A capability discovery and intelligent routing
Authoritative-source verification stages
Human-in-the-loop review and escalation

workstreams.name: AgentOps, Evaluation, and Observability
workstreams.objective: Operate non-deterministic agent systems as versioned, measurable, auditable production workloads.
deliverables: Versioned agent, tool, memory, and configuration artifacts
Evaluation at tool, turn, session, and system levels
Cross-account monitoring and proactive incident response
Traceability, audit trails, quality monitoring, and cost attribution

workstreams.name: Identity, Security, and Multi-Tenant Governance
workstreams.objective: Ensure agents, users, tools, and tenants operate within explicit authorization boundaries and produce auditable actions.
deliverables: AgentCore Identity authentication and token exchange patterns
Machine-to-machine and delegated user access
Secrets governance and KMS-backed key handling
Resource-based policies, tenant isolation, and CloudTrail auditability

workstreams.name: Resilience and LLM Gateway Architecture
workstreams.objective: Maintain model availability and application continuity while centralizing routing and governance across inference providers and regions.
deliverables: Amazon Bedrock cross-Region inference
Intelligent request routing and model fallback
Quota isolation, load balancing, and account sharding
Production LLM gateway patterns and resilience testing

operating_principles: Ground outputs in authorized enterprise sources and retain evidence provenance.
Treat LinkedIn and public professional content as claimed knowledge, not verified proficiency.
Apply least privilege and tenant isolation to every agent, tool, model, and data path.
Version and evaluate agent behavior before and after production deployment.
Design failure handling, routing, and observability before scaling usage.
Keep human review available for consequential or ambiguous actions.
definition_of_done: Agents retrieve only content the requesting principal is authorized to access.
Multi-agent decisions and tool calls are traceable to evidence and identity context.
Evaluation and observability cover development and production behavior.
Inference has documented routing, fallback, quota isolation, and incident-response paths.
The platform exposes cost, latency, errors, quality, and access events to operators.
